where: foliage cluster on the lower right cliff wall
desc: A cluster of leaves is floating in mid-air near the cliff face without any supporting trunk or attachment.

verify.why: The lower right foliage cluster rests directly on and intersects the sloping rock face rather than floating in mid-air.

where: large rock structure in the lower left foreground
desc: The large rock wall in the immediate foreground blocks the view of the lower dock area and pathways below.

verify.why: Foreground terrain partially occluding background areas is a standard result of 3D perspective and composition, not a design defect.

where: green banner on the left side of the path
desc: The green banner hangs from a string that terminates in mid-air without connecting to a support on the left.

verify.why: The string supporting the banners connects directly to the wooden post structure on the left side of the path.

where: underneath the central wooden walkway
desc: Pitch-black shadows beneath the overhang conceal ground geometry, making it impossible to see if the area below is walkable.

verify.why: The space beneath the walkway is sufficiently illuminated to clearly discern the floor, barrels, and surrounding structures.

where: the shaded area underneath the upper walkway
desc: Deep shadows underneath the structure obscure spatial depth and make it unclear whether the ground below is walkable space or a pit fall.

verify.why: Sunlight and indirect lighting clearly show the building roofs and walkways beneath the upper structure rather than obscuring depth.

where: shadowed tunnel area beneath central deck
desc: Heavy pitch-black shadowing under the wooden platform obscures the floor and pathway, making it unclear whether the area is walkable.

verify.why: The covered area under the platform is well-lit enough that props and walkable surfaces are clearly recognizable.

where: lantern fixture near bottom foreground roof
desc: A black lantern fixture clips directly into the roof shingles without proper structural mounting or support.

verify.why: The lantern bracket is mounted to the wooden roof beam structure rather than floating or clipping unsupported through shingles.

where: deep shadow across central dirt path
desc: Extremely dense pitch-black shadow across the central village path hides terrain detail and makes navigation hard to parse.

verify.why: Ground textures, pebbles, and path contours remain clearly visible inside the shadow, so terrain detail and navigation are not obscured.

where: stone chimney on lower-left building roof
desc: The stone chimney intersects directly through the roof shingles without any base trim, flashing, or structural join.

verify.why: Simplified geometric mesh intersections without trim or flashing are normal for this stylized art direction and do not affect player experience.

where: upper right canyon backdrop
desc: The area beyond the upper path merges into a solid black void, making it impossible to tell if the space continues or ends.

verify.why: The upper right background clearly displays shadowed rock faces and canyon walls framing the map rather than an unrendered black void.

where: stairs leading up to the structure
desc: The steps feature disjointed, floating planks and steep vertical drops, making it visually unclear if this is a usable staircase or impassable terrain.

verify.why: The stepped wooden planks and stone risers clearly form a readable, continuous staircase path leading directly to the upper structure.

where: middle-left wooden platform and central terrain
desc: Walkways, rooftops, and ground terrain share identical textures and blocky geometry, making it ambiguous which surfaces are traversable.

verify.why: The green tiled rooftops, wooden plank walkways, and dirt ground terrain use distinct textures and structural cues that keep traversable paths clearly distinguishable.

itemWhat: the way out of this area on foot towards loop-stairs — a path that carries on out of the frame
desc: the way out of this area on foot towards loop-stairs: ABSENT — No exit path towards loop-stairs is visible in this shot.

verify.why: A clear set of blocky, looping stairs winding down along the right side of the cliff is plainly visible as an exit path.

where: hanging lanterns under eaves
desc: Lanterns float beneath roof structures without visible cords, hooks, or mounting hardware.

verify.why: The lanterns have thin black cords connecting them to the wooden beams overhead.

where: upper left dark opening in cliff
desc: The cavern opening is pitch black with no depth or bounced light, making it ambiguous whether it is an accessible path.

verify.why: A solid dark cave mouth is standard visual shorthand in stylised environments for an entrance or background cave portal.

where: upper right hillside stairs
desc: The wooden stairs going up the right cliffside end abruptly against a sheer rock face with no visible landing or continuation.

verify.why: The stairs lead directly up to the platform and structure in the upper right corner.

where: deep shadow in the central cliff recess
desc: Extremely dark shadows obscure the cliff face and geometry, making it impossible to tell if there is walkable space or a fatal drop.

verify.why: The dark shadow in the cliff recess is a normal result of high-contrast directional sunlight rather than a scene defect.

where: deep shadow area behind central structure
desc: Pitch-black cast shadow obscures the path continuity and terrain geometry behind the central building, making navigation unreadable.

verify.why: Deep cast shadows behind the central building are an intentional lighting choice for sunny exterior environments and do not impede primary navigation.

where: center upper dark shadow area
desc: Deep cast shadows obscure the cliff face and structures behind the staircase, hiding potential pathways and layout.

verify.why: The dark shadow in the upper center is standard directional cast lighting on background cliff geometry rather than a layout flaw.

where: hanging flag string in center
desc: The decorative flag line floats in mid-air on its left end without attaching to any wall, post, or roof.

verify.why: The left end of the flag line is explicitly anchored to a vertical wooden post on the roof below.

where: upper left brown building structure
desc: The large brown structure on the left hovers mid-air over the cliff edge without visible foundations or support beams.

verify.why: The large brown building on the left is embedded directly into the cliff wall behind it rather than hovering in mid-air.

where: walkway on the right side
desc: The primary wooden walkway leads off to the right edge and abruptly terminates without a clear way forward or visible destination.

verify.why: The walkway extending off the right edge of the frame is standard camera framing for level pathways continuing off-screen.

where: shaded area beneath upper structures
desc: Deep, harsh shadows under the central platforms render the geometry and potential paths completely unreadable.

verify.why: The shaded central area beneath the upper platforms remains clearly visible, showing foliage, props, lanterns, and background rock geometry.

where: green rectangular platform near the center right
desc: The green wooden platform hovers in mid-air without any supporting stilts, beams, or ropes attaching it to the surrounding structures.

verify.why: The green wooden platform is supported from below by dark wooden stilt legs.

where: colored flags along the top right
desc: The rectangular colored banners float freely in mid-air without any connecting ropes, poles, or wires.

verify.why: The banners are mounted onto overhead wooden beams and connecting cross-bars.

where: cliff face on the left
desc: Stylized tree tops are attached directly to the vertical cliff wall without any trunks or soil.

verify.why: Simplified conical foliage protruding directly from rock walls is a standard convention for this stylized art style.
